methods.label: Meaning of independence
methods.explanation: For events \(A\) and \(B\), independence means that whether one event occurs does not change the probability of the other. Its defining probability relation is \(P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)\). An empty intersection describes mutual exclusivity. Thus the correct choice is A.
methods.levelReason: Uses the required-course meaning and product definition of independence, without formal conditional probability.
